title: Failure Catalogue — Signal Fabric Probe for Payload Triage
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design a compact, scannable Failure Catalogue component (signal fabric probe) that surfaces clustered failed requests, probable root-cause signals, and a lightweight payload inspector for quick triage inside the Redwood Console. The intent is to reduce mean-time-to-resolution for transient retry errors and misrouted model variants by making signal provenance and retry origin explicit and actionable from a single pane.
acceptance_criteria: Catalogue lists clusters of failed requests with sampled query and KV cache fingerprint visible
Each cluster shows top 3 probable root-cause signals (latency spike, model-variant mismatch, auth/403, quota) with confidence scores
Clicking a cluster reveals a right-rail payload probe with request headers, token usage, truncated user prompt, and retry lineage
Interactors for creating a canary rollup or kicking an immediate retry (team-permission gated) are present and match Console RBAC patterns
Figma prototype linked and tested in moderated usability session (n=6) with success metric: median triage time <= 4 minutes
Design handoff includes component specs (states, skeletons, error/no-data fallback) and a short checklist for accessibility and localization
